vb10:0.1: abhidhammapiṭake vibhaṅgappakaraṇaṃ dutiyo bhāgo namo tassa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa
vb10:1.2: satisambojjhaṅgo dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo viriyasambojjhaṅgo pītisambojjhaṅgo passaddhisambojjhaṅgo samādhisambojjhaṅgo upekkhāsambojjhaṅgo.
vb10:2.2: idha bhikkhu satimā hoti paramena satinepakkena samannāgato cirakatampi cirabhāsitampi saritā anussaritā,
vb10:3.1: so tathā sato viharanto taṃ dhammaṃ paññāya vicinati pavicinati pavicarati. parivīmaṃsamāpajjati,
vb10:4.1: tassa taṃ dhammaṃ paññāya vicinato pavicinato pavicarato parivīmaṃsamāpajjato āraddhaṃ hoti viriyaṃ asallīnaṃ,
vb10:8.1: so tathā samāhitaṃ cittaṃ sādhukaṃ ajjhupekkhitā hoti,
vb10:9.2: satisambojjhaṅgo dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo viriyasambojjhaṅgo pītisambojjhaṅgo passaddhisambojjhaṅgo samādhisambojjhaṅgo upekkhāsambojjhaṅgo.
vb10:10.2: atthi ajjhattaṃ dhammesu sati, atthi bahiddhā dhammesu sati.
vb10:10.3: yada’pi ajjhattaṃ dhammesu sati tada’pi satisambojjhaṅgo abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati,
vb10:10.4: yada’pi bahiddhā dhammesu sati tada’pi satisambojjhaṅgo abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati.
vb10:11.2: atthi ajjhattaṃ dhammesu pavicayo, atthi bahiddhā dhammesu pavicayo.
vb10:11.3: yada’pi ajjhattaṃ dhammesu pavicayo tada’pi dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati,
vb10:11.4: yada’pi bahiddhā dhammesu pavicayo tada’pi dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati.
vb10:12.2: atthi kāyikaṃ viriyaṃ, atthi cetasikaṃ viriyaṃ.
vb10:12.3: yada’pi kāyikaṃ viriyaṃ tada’pi viriyasambojjhaṅgo abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati,
vb10:12.4: yada’pi cetasikaṃ viriyaṃ tada’pi viriyasambojjhaṅgo abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati.
vb10:13.2: atthi savitakkasavicārā pīti, atthi avitakkaavicārā pīti.
vb10:13.3: yada’pi savitakkasavicārā pīti tada’pi pīti sambojjhaṅgo abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati.
vb10:13.4: yada’pi avitakkaavicārā pīti tada’pi pītisambojjhaṅgo abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati.
vb10:14.3: yada’pi kāyapassaddhi tada’pi passaddhisambojjhaṅgo abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati,
vb10:14.4: yada’pi cittapassaddhi tada’pi passaddhisambojjhaṅgo abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati.
vb10:15.2: atthi savitakkasavicāro samādhi, atthi avitakkaavicāro samādhi.
vb10:15.3: yada’pi savitakkasavicāro samādhi tada’pi samādhisambojjhaṅgo abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati,
vb10:15.4: yada’pi avitakkaavicāro samādhi tada’pi samādhisambojjhaṅgo abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati.
vb10:16.2: atthi ajjhattaṃ dhammesu upekkhā, atthi bahiddhā dhammesu upekkhā.
vb10:16.3: yada’pi ajjhattaṃ dhammesu upekkhā tada’pi upekkhāsambojjhaṅgo abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati,
vb10:16.4: yada’pi bahiddhā dhammesu upekkhā tada’pi upekkhāsambojjhaṅgo abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati.
vb10:17.2: satisambojjhaṅgo dhammevicaya sambojjhaṅgo viriyasambojjhaṅgo pītisambojjhaṅgo passaddhisambojjhaṅgo samādhisambojjhaṅgo upekkhāsambojjhaṅgo.
vb10:18.2: idha bhikkhu satisambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ,
vb10:18.8: upekkhāsambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ.
vb10:20.2: satisambojjhaṅgo dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo viriyasambojjhaṅgo pītisambojjhaṅgo passaddhisambojjhaṅgo samādhisambojjhaṅgo upekkhāsambojjhaṅgo.
vb10:21.2: idha bhikkhu yasmiṃ samaye lokuttaraṃ jhānaṃ bhāveti niyyānikaṃ apacayagāmiṃ diṭṭhigatānaṃ pahānāya paṭhamāya bhūmiyā pattiyā vivicce’va kāmehi …pe… paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati dukkhāpaṭipadaṃ dandhābhiññaṃ. tasmiṃ samaye sattabojjhaṅgā honti.
vb10:22.2: yā sati anussati paṭissati sati saraṇatā dhāraṇatā apilāpanatā asammussanatā sati satindriyaṃ satibalaṃ sammāsati satisambojjhaṅgo maggaṅgaṃ maggapariyāpannaṃ,
vb10:23.2: yā paññā pajānanā …pe… amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo maggaṅgaṃ maggapariyāpannaṃ,
vb10:24.2: yo cetasiko viriyārambho …pe… sammāvāyāmā viriyasambojjhaṅgo maggaṅgaṃ maggapariyāpannaṃ,
vb10:25.2: yā pīti pāmojjaṃ āmodanā pamodanā hāso pahāso vitti odagyaṃ attamanatā cittassa pītisambojjhaṅgo,
vb10:26.2: yā vedanākkhandhassa saññākkhandhassa saṅkhārakkhandhassa viññāṇakkhandhassa passaddhi paṭippassaddhi passambhanā paṭippassambhanā paṭippassambhitattaṃ passaddhisambojjhaṅgo,
vb10:27.2: yā cittassa ṭhiti …pe… sammāsamādhi samādhisambojjhaṅgo maggaṅgaṃ maggapariyāpannaṃ,
vb10:28.2: yā upekkhā upekkhanā ajjhupekkhanā majjhattatā cittassa upekkhāsambojjhaṅgo,
vb10:30.2: idha bhikkhu yasmiṃ samaye lokuttaraṃ jhānaṃ bhāveti niyyānikaṃ apacayagāmiṃ diṭṭhigatānaṃ pahānāya paṭhamāya bhūmiyā pattiyā vivicce’va kāmehi …pe… paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati dukkhāpaṭipadaṃ dandhābhiññaṃ. yā tasmiṃ samaye sati anussati …pe… sammāsati satisambojjhaṅgo maggaṅgaṃ maggapariyāpannaṃ,
vb10:31.2: idha bhikkhu yasmiṃ samaye lokuttaraṃ jhānaṃ bhāveti niyyānikaṃ apacayagāmiṃ diṭṭhigatānaṃ pahānāya paṭhamāya bhūmiyā pattiyā vivicce’va kāmehi …pe… paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati dukkhāpaṭipadaṃ dandhābhiññaṃ. yā tasmiṃ samaye upekkhā upekkhanā ajjhupekkhanā majjhattatā cittassa upekkhā sambojjhaṅgo,
vb10:33.2: idha bhikkhu yasmiṃ samaye lokuttaraṃ jhānaṃ bhāveti niyyānikaṃ apacayagāmiṃ diṭṭhigatānaṃ pahānāya paṭhamāya bhūmiyā pattiyā vivicce’va kāmehi …pe… paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati dukkhāpaṭipadaṃ dandhābhiññaṃ. yo tasmiṃ samaye phasso hoti …pe… avikkhepo hoti,
vb10:33.4: tasse’va lokuttarassa kusalassa jhānassa katattā bhāvitattā vipākaṃ vivicce’va kāmehi …pe… paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati dukkhāpaṭipadaṃ dandhābhiññaṃ suññataṃ. tasmiṃ samaye sattabojjhaṅgā honti
vb10:34.2: yā sati anussati …pe… sammāsati satisambojjhaṅgo maggaṅgaṃ maggapariyāpannaṃ,
vb10:35.2: yā upekkhā upekkhanā ajjhupekkhanā majjhattatā cittassa upekkhāsambojjhaṅgo,
vb10:37.2: idha bhikkhu yasmiṃ samaye lokuttaraṃ jhānaṃ bhāveti niyyānikaṃ apacayagāmiṃ diṭṭhigatānaṃ pahānāya paṭhamāya bhūmiyā pattiyā vivicce’va kāmehi …pe… paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati dukkhāpaṭipadaṃ dandhābhiññaṃ. tasmiṃ samaye phasso hoti …pe… avikkhepo hoti,
vb10:37.4: tasse’va lokuttarassa kusalassa jhānassa katattā bhāvitattā vipākaṃ vivicce’va kāmehi …pe… paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati dukkhāpaṭipadaṃ dandhābhiññaṃ suññataṃ. yā tasmiṃ samaye sati anussati …pe… sammāsati sati sambojjhaṅgo maggaṅgaṃ maggapariyāpannaṃ,
vb10:38.2: idha bhikkhu yasmiṃ samaye lokuttaraṃ jhānaṃ bhāveti niyyānikaṃ apacayagāmiṃ diṭṭhigatānaṃ pahānāya paṭhamāya bhūmiyā pattiyā vivicce’va ‘kāmehi …pe… paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati dukkhāpaṭipaṭipadaṃ dandhābhiññaṃ. tasmiṃ samaye phasso hoti …pe… avikkhepo hoti,
vb10:38.4: tasse’va lokuttarassa kusalassa jhānassa katattā bhāvitattā vipākaṃ vivicce’va kāmehi …pe… paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati dukkhāpaṭipadaṃ dandhābhiññaṃ suññataṃ. yā tasmiṃ samaye upekkhā upekkhanā ajjhupekkhanā majjhattatā cittassa upekkhā sambojjhaṅgo,
vb10:40.2: satisambojjhaṅgo dhammavicaya sambojjhaṅgo viriyasambojjhaṅgo pītisambojjhaṅgo passaddhisambojjhaṅgo samādhisambojjhaṅgo upekkhāsambojjhaṅgo.
vb10:41.1: sattannaṃ bojjhaṅgānaṃ kati kusalā, kati akusalā, kati avyākatā …pe… kati saraṇā, kati araṇā:
vb10:43.2: cha bojjhaṅgā siyā sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā, siyā adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā.
vb10:47.1: siyā savitakkasavicārā, siyā avitakkavicāramattā, siyā avitakka avicārā.
vb10:48.1: pītisambojjhaṅgo na pītisahagato sukhasahagato na upekkhāsahagato.
vb10:48.2: cha bojjhaṅgā siyā pītisahagatā, siyā sukhasahagatā, siyā upekkhāsahagatā.
vb10:57.1: na maggārammaṇā, siyā maggahetukā, siyā maggādhipatino,
vb10:58.1: siyā uppannā, siyā anuppannā, siyā uppādino.
vb10:59.1: siyā atītā, siyā anāgatā, siyā paccuppannā.
vb10:60.1: na vattabbā atītārammaṇāti’pi anāgatārammaṇāti’pi paccuppannā rammaṇāti’pi.
vb10:61.1: siyā ajjhattā siyā bahiddhā siyā ajjhattabahiddhā.
vb10:64.1: dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo hetu. cha bojjhaṅgā na hetu. sahetukā. hetusampayuttā.
vb10:64.2: dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo hetu ceva sahetuko ca cha bojjhaṅgā na vattabbā hetu ceva sahetukā’ti sahetukā ceva na ca hetu.
vb10:64.3: dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo hetu ceva hetusampayutto ca, cha bojjhaṅgā na vattabbā hetu ceva hetusampayuttā’ti, hetusampayuttā’ti, hetu sampayuttā ceva na ca hetu.
vb10:64.4: cha bojjhaṅgā na hetu sahetukā. dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo na vattabbo na hetu sahetukoti’pi na hetu ahetukoti’pi
vb10:66.4: na vattabbā āsavā ceva sāsavāti’pi sāsavā ce’va no ca āsavāti’pi.
vb10:66.5: na vattabbā āsavā ceva āsavasampayuttāti’pi āsavasampayuttā ceva no ca āsavāti’pi.
vb10:70.1: pītisambojjhaṅgo appītiko. cha bojjhaṅgā siyā sappītikā siyā appītikā.
vb10:70.2: pītisambojjhaṅgo na pītisahagato. cha bojjhaṅgā siyā pītisahagatā siyā na pītisahagatā.
vb10:70.3: pītisambojjhaṅgo sukhasahagato. cha bojjhaṅgā siyā sukhasahagatā, siyā na sukhasahagatā.
vb10:70.4: pītisambojjhaṅgo na upekkhāsahagato. cha bojjhaṅgā siyā upekkhāsahagatā siyā na upekkhāsahagatā.
